title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the full public launch of Spyglass, providing a powerful and intuitive tool to help you discover valuable insights with unparalleled ease.

title: Enhanced File Control in the Editor
summary: We've launched new tools that give you unparalleled control over images and other files, allowing for effortless uploading, management, and tailored display right within your editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap!
summary: Get an exclusive look at our progress and upcoming features with the brand new public roadmap, providing full transparency into our development journey.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now featuring easier clicking, seamless dragging, and a modern look consistent with our platform.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Our latest updates deliver a smoother and more insightful collaborative editing experience, empowering teams to work together with greater ease and clarity.

title: Seamless Sharing & Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to find, access, and collaborate on all your shared ideas and quests, fostering richer connections and productivity.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're excited to open-source Noeko under a flexible license, giving you maximum control and transparency to directly contribute to and shape our project's future.

title: Noeko Goes Global: Multilingual Support
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in your preferred language, as we roll out exciting new support for users worldwide.

title: Expanded & Enhanced Themes
summary: We're launching an exciting collection of brand-new themes and refining existing favorites to offer a more diverse and visually stunning experience for all users.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your interconnected ideas with powerful new filters and shared insights, transforming your knowledge base into an interactive hub for deeper understanding and streamlined workflows.

title: Discover and Curate Your Knowledge with Enhanced Search
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your information with powerful filtering, custom sorting, and the ability to save your perfectly curated knowledge views for quick retrieval.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Transform your notes into an interactive knowledge hub with dynamic content views that intelligently present linked information in ways that suit your thinking.

title: Noeko: Your Way - Self-Hosted & Premium Editions
summary: Gain ultimate control with self-hosting options and unlock enhanced capabilities for individuals and teams through Noeko's new flexible premium plans.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with perfectly timed greetings, ensuring you always receive the right welcome, day or night.

title: Powerful Tag List Management
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your tagged items by deleting, unapplying tags, and viewing details directly from any tag list, making management swift and simple.

title: Diverse Content Integration
summary: Effortlessly bring all your essential information into one place with support for diverse content types such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files.
